target.identity_method: Fresh extraction from the exact checksum-verified published portable ZIP followed by Get-FileHash comparison.

attempts.evidence: This BinSkim build requires explicit true values for boolean command options; argument parsing stopped before scanning and produced no SARIF.

attempts.reason: The executable was not evaluated because its PDB could not be loaded (E_PDB_NO_DEBUG_INFO).
The ignore option prevented a failing process exit but did not cause the target to be evaluated. Zero results must not be described as a clean scan.

raw_evidence.reason: The SARIF embeds a local temporary extraction path.

digest_observation.disposition: Do not use the BinSkim SARIF digest as distribution identity. GitHub release SHA-256, container reconciliation, Get-FileHash, and Sigcheck independently identify the published executable. No equivalence is inferred.

finding.title: BinSkim could not evaluate the published PyInstaller executable without a loadable PDB
finding.security_relevance: BinSkim-specific PE/MSIL rule coverage was not obtained; other PE identity, manifest, version, signature, and structural checks do not substitute for those rules.
finding.recommendation: For a future build, determine whether a reviewed matching PyInstaller bootloader PDB can be produced/preserved or select documented BinSkim rules and binary inputs that can be evaluated without symbols. Continue to treat zero results from an unsuccessful invocation as no evidence.
